title: A deposit link paid after the Bill To changed is refused
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks a customer portal change that ships in the customer portal app's own release (the Bill To PRD's release dependency for the customer portal story). Do not run it now. It can be tested once that portal release is out.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the new payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, with no deposit taken.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Create a deposit link for $25.00.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
  5. Click the Bill To field.
  6. Pick customer C in the list.
  7. Open the deposit link in another browser.
  8. Pay the $25.00 with a test card.
  9. Switch back to work order 1's Finance tab.
  10. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows its deposit actions.

Step 3:

  • A deposit link for $25.00 is made while customer B is the Bill To.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • The list opens.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 7:

  • The portal payment page for $25.00 opens.

Step 8:

  • The payment is refused with "This work order is now billed to another customer. Contact the shop."
  • No card is charged.

Step 9:

  • The Finance tab is open.

Step 10:

  • No deposit is recorded on work order 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12318 (Story 16, Customer portal)

  • S16-R6: “A deposit link remembers the Bill To the work order had when staff created it.”
  • S16-R7: “If the work order's Bill To has changed since, paying the link is refused with G3 before any card is charged; no deposit is recorded.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “G3 | Customer portal: a deposit link is paid after the work order's Bill To changed | "This work order is now billed to another customer. Contact the shop." | Portal payment error; no card is charged”
  • Story 16, Release dependency: “Release dependency: the customer portal app ships S16-R2 to S16-R4 and runs ShopView's deposit check before it charges a card for a deposit link, showing the G3 message verbatim. ShopView also refuses to record such a deposit with G3.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
